title: Dynamic cherrys
description: Make cherrys grow on cherry trees like they should. Craft them into red dye and eat them for food.
body: Dynamic Cherrys is a small Fabric mod that adds pickable cherries to natural cherry trees. Like the apple mod, it scans cherry leaves and shows fruit in exposed spots, then lets players right-click or break the leaf to collect a cherry. The mod stays simple: no sapling or worldgen changes, just dynamic fruit, an edible cherry item, red dye crafting, sugar from smelting, and composter support. It uses a SeedDelight-style cherry texture while keeping the code separate and lightweight. Very simple.
